gloss: on the occasion of; when; at the time of

definitions.gloss: on the occasion of; when; at the time of
definitions.explanation: A formal expression used to mark a significant occasion or important moment as the context for what follows. Attaches to nouns or verb dictionary forms.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}にあたって、{一言|ひとこと}{挨拶|あいさつ}します。
examples.english: On the occasion of graduation, I would like to say a few words.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいプロジェクトを{始|はじ}めるにあたって、{準備|じゅんび}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: In starting the new project, preparation is necessary.

examples.japanese: {開会|かいかい}にあたって、{会長|かいちょう}から{皆様|みなさま}にご{挨拶|あいさつ}がございます。
examples.english: On the occasion of the opening, the chairperson will offer greetings to everyone.

notes:
A formal compound particle meaning "on the occasion of" or "when undertaking." Derived from the verb {当|あ}たる (to correspond to / to face). Used in speeches, formal writing, and business contexts to frame an important event or action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + にあたって: {卒業|そつぎょう}にあたって (on the occasion of graduation)
- Verb dictionary form + にあたって: {始|はじ}めるにあたって (when starting)
- にあたり is a slightly more formal variant used in the same way

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開催|かいさい}にあたって: on the occasion of holding (an event)
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}にあたって: upon departure
- {就任|しゅうにん}にあたって: upon taking office
- {実施|じっし}にあたって: in carrying out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- に{際|さい}して: on the occasion of — very similar meaning, slightly more formal and written
- にあたり: variant form of にあたって — interchangeable in most contexts
- {時|とき}に: when — neutral and general; にあたって adds formality and weight to the occasion
